message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta.  
Here’s how:

1. **Online** – Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website and use the “Report a Noise Complaint” form under the Public Safety section.  
2. **Phone** – Call the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line at 404‑656‑4000 and ask to speak with the Noise Enforcement Unit.  
3. **In person** – You can also stop by your local police precinct or the City Hall’s Public Records office to submit a written complaint.

When filing, include:
- Your name and contact info  
- Exact time(s) and location of the disturbance  
- Description of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs)  
- Any relevant evidence (photos, videos, audio recordings)

The city’s noise ordinance covers excessive sound levels, especially during nighttime hours (typically 10 p.m.–7 a.m.). Once filed, the police will investigate and may issue warnings or citations depending on the severity.
